image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a classic car wheel. The wheel features a chrome or polished aluminum rim with a distinct raised lip and a five-spoke alloy design in the center. A black rubber tire with a white sidewall stripe (whitewall) is mounted on the rim. The background shows a portion of a red car fender at the top and gray asphalt at the bottom. There is visible text/watermark in the bottom right corner.
